industrial_overkill:omnivorous_generator: Burn food and solid furnace fuels for FE. Redstone or a full buffer prevents ignition. Burning fuel is reserved until it finishes, and excess FE is lost. Collect containers, charcoal, and ash on the right.
industrial_overkill:agri_brain.info: Scans one block every 20 work ticks (10 game ticks with eight Gearbox Upgrades), row by row, then repeats. A rotating green particle column shows the current block. Insert a hoe to till dirt and grass below the crop layer when the space above is clear. Successful tills use half the normal tool wear; Unbreaking still applies. Base scanning costs 5 FE/t, up to 10 FE/t with eight gearboxes. Successful actions cost extra: planting 100 FE, tilling 200 FE, harvesting 100 FE. Cancelled or blocked actions charge no extra. Unaffordable actions wait for a later pass; below 5 FE the scan stops until power returns. Pause freezes the scan; range changes restart it. The area button shows or hides the crop area behind the machine. Starts at 3×3; each Range Upgrade adds 1 to the radius, up to 21×21 with nine upgrades. Install one per general slot. Upgrades never wear out. Harvests fully grown crops, refills seed inputs first and stores remaining drops in the 3×3 output. Leaves crops intact if their drops cannot fit. Replants empty farmland using the selected planting mode. Each Gearbox Upgrade adds 12.5% processor speed and FE usage rate, up to +100% with eight. Gearboxes never wear out. Each Capacitor Upgrade adds 12.5% energy storage and input/output rate, up to +100% with eight. Removing capacitors clamps excess stored FE to the reduced capacity.
item.industrial_overkill.range_upgrade.s: One per general upgrade slot. Agri-Brain: up to 9. Never wears out.
item.industrial_overkill.gearbox_upgrade: +12.5% processor speed and FE usage rate per upgrade.
Stacks to 8 in the gearbox socket. Never wears out.
agri.seeds: Seeds (numbered left to right, top to bottom)
agri.irrigation.water: Water use scales from 100 mB for completely dry farmland to 0 mB at full moisture.
agri.output: Harvest output — seeds refill inputs first. Harvesting waits if drops cannot fit.
agri.planting.help.0: Plants from the first non-empty seed slot, in slot order.
agri.planting.help.1: Plants once from each slot in turn, skipping empty slots. The green border marks the next slot. Advances only after successful planting.
agri.planting.help.2: Rows nearest the machine come first. Rows 1, 5, 9 use slot 1; rows 2, 6, 10 use slot 2, and so on. Missing seeds leave their rows empty.
agri.fertilizer.help.0: Let crops grow at their usual pace.
agri.fertilizer.help.1: Apply pellets when planting. Use regular fertilizer on growing crops and prefer filtered fertilizer when two stages remain.
agri.fertilizer.help.2: Fertilize only when the full dose will mature the crop for harvest.
agri.fertilizer.help.3: Apply pellets when planting and let their later boosts run on their own.
agri.fertilizer.regular: Regular fertilizer advances a crop by one stage.
agri.fertilizer.alternative: Bone meal or another compatible fertilizer advances a crop by one stage.
agri.fertilizer.filtered: Filtered fertilizer advances a crop by two stages.
agri.fertilizer.pellets: Slow-release pellets advance two stages now, then one after 30 seconds and another after 60 seconds.
industrial_overkill:ranch_controller.inf: Tends one herd behind the controller. Load a bucket or compatible container to milk adult cows. Install add-ons in the Upgrades drawer to breed, feed young animals, shear sheep or pack surplus adults into empty Critter Couriers. The area starts at 5×5×3 and grows with Range Upgrades.
ranch.feed: Food input requires Pair Pressure or Snackcelerator
ranch.containers: Load a bucket or compatible fluid container to milk cows. The last empty bucket stays here to fill the tank.
ranch.couriers: Empty Critter Courier input requires Livestock To Go
ranch.output: Wool, filled containers, and occupied Critter Couriers
ranch.adults_target.down: Lower the shared breeding and packing target.
ranch.adults_target.up: Raise the shared breeding and packing target.
industrial_overkill:honest_sewer.info: Collects 25 mB of sewage per live animal in range every 30 seconds without power, or every 5 seconds at 2 FE per tick. Pipe the sewage to a filter or directly to a fertilizer maker.
industrial_overkill:sewage_filter.info: The input fluid determines the recipe. Sewage yields filtered sewage and occasional salvage. Filtered sewage yields water and filter cake. Empty the output tank before switching to a recipe that produces a different fluid.
industrial_overkill:fertilizer_maker.inf: Liquid mode selects a recipe from the input tank. Sewage and filtered sewage batches also produce 50 mB of water. A filter cake can stand in for four seeds in a liquid batch. Pellet mode uses cake and seeds together.
waste.maker.cycle: Switch between liquid recipes and pellets.
waste.maker.help.0: Use 100 mB of sewage, filtered sewage, or water. Either sewage recipe also produces 50 mB of water.
waste.maker.help.1: Use one cake and eight seeds for two slow-release pellets.
waste.maker.cake: Filter cake substitutes for four seeds in liquid batches.
waste.maker.liquid_input: Sewage, filtered sewage, or water input
agri.hoe: Hoe input — one durability per two successful tills. Unbreaking applies; skipped blocks cost nothing.
agri.upgrades.gearbox: Gearbox socket — up to 8. Each adds 12.5% speed and FE usage rate. Never wears out.
agri.upgrades.capacitor: Capacitor socket — up to 8. Each adds 12.5% storage and input/output rate. Never wears out.
gym.redstone.working.help: Emits 15 while the gym is generating power; otherwise 0.
gym.title: Animal Gym 2.0
gym.food.no_animal: Add an animal to see its accepted foods and energy per food.
gym.food.none: This animal has no supported gym foods.
gym.food.unsuitable: This animal does not eat this food.
gym.status.waiting: Lead an adult onto the belt
gym.help: Lead a supported adult animal onto the belt, or insert an occupied Critter Courier to keep it contained. Supply its food and connect an FE consumer. When full, the gym rests until energy drops to 75%; it keeps exporting power without spending food. The right side holds the belt and the top holds the hanging food; neither supports side or redstone connections. Remove the courier to take the animal with you. Use the run control to pause or resume.
gym.release.tip: Release a loose animal, or return its occupied courier.
courier.title: Critter Courier
courier.release_failed: Cannot restore this mob here. Its data remains safe in the courier.
courier.release.tip: Release the mob into clear space beside the cage.
courier.pickup.tip: Pick up this courier with its occupant safely inside.
courier.no_space: Clear space next to the courier before releasing the mob.
gym.trap.help: Insert an occupied courier. Remove it to take the animal with you.
gym.status.unsupported: This mob cannot power the gym
jei.industrial_overkill.gym.title: Animal Gym
jei.industrial_overkill.gym.selector_too: Click to cycle intensity: 1 → 2 → 3 → 1. Updates all animal previews and food rates.
industrial_overkill:rock_stew_factory.in: Choose a production path from a water/lava stone to its destination. Stages run together and share FE. None / One Run / Full Stack are refill targets. Processing reserves consumed ingredients before extraction. Changing paths cancels active work and preserves stored items. Each tank holds 4000 ml. Generation starts only with at least 1000 ml of both water and lava; recipe consumption comes out of that amount. Below 1000 ml, generation waits for refill. Furnaces need no water and can use remaining lava down to zero.
stew.recovery: Saved work needs recovery. Contents and the original work snapshot are retained; processing is stopped.
stew.disabled: Not used by this production path
stew.stock.one: Producing only 1 cycle input for next processor
stew.open_tree: Click to choose a production path
stew.jei_select: With Rock Stew open, use JEI's + button to apply this production path.
